building_extra.name: Overview of Hunter's Portfolio
building_extra.blurb: Interactive AI CV: agentic RAG, an eval harness that grades it on 38 questions, and 6-layer security, all on free tiers under $5/mo.

building_extra.name: VibeBloat
building_extra.blurb: Reads your agent history and compiles every mistake so the same one is never made twice. Zero token cost.

building_extra.name: ATFG AI Platform
building_extra.blurb: Multi-model AI platform I built end to end for outreach, client management, recruiting, and operational automation, with 92% month-over-month retention. Private.

building_extra.name: VBrain
building_extra.blurb: A heavily modified fork of GBrain: a persistent graph-memory system with typed entity edges and zero-LLM extraction, so agents never lose context across sessions. Private.

contributing_extra.name: Printing Press
contributing_extra.blurb: Created and contributed **[Paperclip CLI](https://printingpress.dev/library/project-management/paperclip-self-hosted)**, an agent-native CLI, skill, and MCP server for self-hosted Paperclip, plus **[Zillow CLI](https://printingpress.dev/library/other/zillow)**, a housing-market CLI and MCP server using Zillow Research datasets, local SQLite sync, data-quality checks, and explainable market analysis.

DietrichGebert/ponytail#686.blurb: Fixes a crash that could happen when a rule is set up incorrectly. Broken rules are now skipped safely and everything else keeps working.

block/buzz#4742.blurb: Makes turning a workflow 'off' actually stick. Disabled workflows no longer run through any trigger, and they stay off even after a restart.

NousResearch/hermes-agent#76616.blurb: Adds a safe way to restart the Hermes Desktop app's current connection, with a confirmation prompt before anything happens. Cloud and remote connections keep their existing behavior.

garrytan/gbrain#3776.blurb: Restores search-by-meaning for saved insights, so the think feature can find related notes even when the wording is different.

stablyai/orca#12139.blurb: Fixes the Tasks view when it pulls items from several GitHub repos at once, so the list is complete, correctly ordered, and nothing gets skipped or duplicated.

garrytan/gbrain#3832.blurb: Fixes the autopilot feature on Windows by finding its own launcher more reliably, with extra safety checks against common startup problems.

mvanhorn/last30days-skill#948.blurb: Makes the Python and bash versions of the environment loader handle comments and quotes the same way, so the documented examples work as written.

mvanhorn/printing-press-library#1669.blurb: Adds greenhouse-pp-cli, a simple command-line tool that lists open jobs from any company's public Greenhouse job board. No account or API key needed.

mvanhorn/printing-press-library#1670.blurb: Adds lever-pp-cli, the same kind of tool for Lever job boards, pulling live job postings for any company.

mvanhorn/printing-press-library#1672.blurb: Adds opensky-pp-cli, a free command-line tool that tracks live aircraft using public flight data.
